integrity: All finite graph and state classifications use source-complete exact integer enumerators, with two separately implemented finite-dynamical classifiers and exact output replay; independent external audit has not been performed.
limitations: Sharp minimum and uniqueness hold only among connected simple cubic bipartite graphs. The result is a complete finite census through twelve vertices, not an infinite-order characterization. Historical priority is not externally certified.
title: A unique twelve-vertex cubic bipartite network with two excitation-period halving channels
